title: Michael L NDE 6167
content: Before the surgery, I was taken to the operating room where my gown was removed and my arms were stretched out as the IVs were inserted. I remember saying to myself, 'Jesus, this is what they did to you.' I was put to sleep and then I was out of my body looking down at what was being done to me. To my right was another individual whose face I never saw. I saw my heart being removed as the doctors needed to reach arteries. Then I saw my heart replaced and watched as the surgeons tried to unsuccessfully restart my heart with small paddles. At this point, I started to laugh and the person standing next to me asked why I was laughing. I responded, saying, 'look, they're all in a panic, how funny.' Eventually my heart was restarted and the individual with me said, 'come, we have to go.' I was taken to a very narrow door and the person with me told me to open the door and go in. That was the last I saw or heard this individual. I entered through the door and immediately felt an intense feeling of love and warmth. As I walked I saw a beautiful field with an intense blue sky. The blue color was unlike I had ever seen in my life. I then became aware of beautiful music coming from everywhere; rocks, trees, grass, etc. were all praising god. I saw no one but as I turned I saw a throne or alter, I don't know which, with multiple colors streaming from it. In the center was an intense white light, which didn't hurt my eyes but the feeling of love got stronger. 24 hours later, in the recovery, I woke up in agony. Though I couldn't talk, I screamed inside, 'Jesus don't leave me here, take me back.' There was no response to my plea. Two days later, my heart went into defibrillation for 5 hours, which the doctors couldn't stop. During that time, I kept praying for help. As my condition worsened, I said, 'God, why did you show me what you did and now you won't help?' Immediately I felt a hand on my chest and a voice said, 'Mich'l, I heard you but remember I answer in my time not yours.' At that time, the nurses and doctors came running into my room to tell me my heart was now working normally. Several weeks later, at home, I was asleep on the couch when I suddenly felt myself going through a multicolored tunnel at enormous speed then suddenly I was going backwards through this tunnel, at which time I awoke. My wife was standing over me and said I had stopped breathing.

tunnel.passage_other_detail: Taken to a very narrow door; later (weeks later) described going through a multicolored tunnel at enormous speed and then going backwards through it.

arrival.other_being_detail: An individual to his right during the OBE whose face he never saw; later a 'hand on my chest' and a 'voice' speaking to him during prolonged defibrillation.

environment.environment_other_detail: Beautiful field; intense blue sky; music coming from everywhere (rocks, trees, grass) praising God; a throne/altar with multiple colors streaming from it; intense white light at the center.

context.nde_cause_other_detail: Heart surgery with inability to restart heart initially; later prolonged defibrillation episode; later episode at home where wife said he had stopped breathing.

stage_sequence.elements_other_detail: Also includes auditory phenomenon: music from everywhere; and later a voice speaking during defibrillation episode.
stage_sequence.sequence_variation_description: OBE during surgery with observation of resuscitation, then escorted to a narrow door (boundary) leading into a field with music and light; later separate episodes include hearing a voice/feeling a hand during defibrillation and a later multicolored tunnel experience at home.
stage_sequence.repeated_stage_detail: Multiple episodes: initial surgical OBE/realm entry; later voice/hand during defibrillation; later tunnel episode at home.

unique_elements.nonstandard_elements: Nature (rocks, trees, grass) 'praising god' as music coming from everywhere; a throne/altar with multiple colors streaming from it; later separate tunnel episode weeks afterward where he went backward through the tunnel and awoke; auditory/physical contact ('hand on my chest') and voice during prolonged defibrillation.
unique_elements.notable_quotes: 'look, they're all in a panic, how funny.'; 'Jesus don't leave me here, take me back.'; 'Mich'l, I heard you but remember I answer in my time not yours.'
